name: Bootstrap Multiselect
description: Integration with the Bootstrap Multiselect library.
project_description: Provides a Drupal asset library that wraps David Stutz's bootstrap-multiselect jQuery plugin (version 1.1.1), which turns a native multiple-select into a Bootstrap dropdown of checkboxes. The module registers a single library ('bootstrap_multiselect/multiselect') and nothing else — no form element, field widget, configuration form, route, or service. By default the CSS and JS are pulled from cdnjs; if the files are placed under the site's /libraries folder they are served locally instead (see https://www.drupal.org/node/3099614). Attaching the library and initialising the plugin on a select element is left to the consuming theme or module.
